item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00805","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final number 6186 after correct formulas, which yield 859 balloons per school.","case2_error":"Incorrectly reduces the homework workload by two hours and excludes weekend nights from available nights.","reason":"Case 1 supplies an unsupported number after correct setup; case 2 explicitly uses incorrect workload and scheduling relations.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00806","case1_error":"Leading answer marker says 40, but the derivation correctly obtains a 50 mph speed limit.","case2_error":"Omits Ariana's half-hour when calculating Sarah's remaining running time, inflating the total distance.","reason":"Case 1 has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00807","case1_error":"Applies the 20% car-payment fraction to gross income instead of after-tax income.","case2_error":"Sets feeding cost equal to purchase cost, omitting the stated 20% increase.","reason":"Case 1 uses the wrong income base for a percentage; case 2 omits a percentage increase from a cost.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00808","case1_error":"Models five child tickets and five adult tickets instead of three child tickets and two adult tickets.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written sum 8 + 12 + 16 + 4 as 30 instead of 40.","reason":"Case 1 builds an equation with incorrect category counts; case 2 makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00809","case1_error":"Multiplies area by coverage before dividing by coverage, incorrectly leaving the area value as the number of gallons.","case2_error":"Uses the 40 good-soil acres as the clay-rich acreage instead of 20 acres.","reason":"Case 1 uses an incorrect area-to-paint conversion relation; case 2 substitutes the wrong category's acreage into an otherwise appropriate yield calculation.","judgment":"different"}]}
